parsed.reason: INV-1076 is $2,450.00 at the contract rate, and its qty of 1 matches the PO received qty of 1. The earlier same-amount invoices (INV-1007, INV-1058) cite the same PO-1012, so duplicate_invoice does not apply. The amount is under $5,000 and the bank change on day 42 came after receipt on day 41, so vendor_bank_change does not apply. No hold rule applies. Note that this is the third invoice against a one-unit PO-1012, which the listed hold rules do not cover.
